attributes.name: Commander Kyan Kain
attributes.powers:
Before you act, recharge a card, then summon and encounter the ship Dominator.

You may not play boons that have the Pirate or Swashbuckling trait on the check to defeat the villain.

If undefeated, discard as many cards from the blessings deck as there are closed locations.

"What have we here? Fish out of water? Marines! Show these dogs what Cheliax does to pirates!"—Commander Kyan Kain
